title: Can Agents Price a Reaction? Evaluating LLMs on Chemical Cost Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2605.07251v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become increasingly capable as tool-using agents, with benchmarks spanning diverse general agentic tasks. Yet rigorous evaluation of scientific tool use remains limited. In chemistry, recent agents can plan syntheses and invoke domain-specific tools, but evaluations often rely on curated demonstrations, expert assessment, or LLM-as-judge scoring rather than exact, judge-free ground truth. We address this gap with chemical procurement cost estimation, a practical task in which an agent must ground chemical identities, retrieve supplier quotes, select valid purchasable packs, normalize quantities, and compute cost from a reaction description. translated_title: 智能体能为化学反应定价吗？评估大语言模型的化学品成本推理能力
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）作为使用工具的智能体能力日益增强，现有基准已涵盖多种通用智能体任务。然而，对科学工具使用的严格评估仍然有限。在化学领域，近期的智能体虽然能够规划合成路线并调用领域特定工具，但其评估往往依赖精心策划的演示、专家评审或以LLM作为评判者的打分，而非精确的、无需评判者的真实标准。我们通过化学品采购成本估算任务来填补这一空白。这是一项实际任务，智能体需要根据反应描述完成以下工作：确定化学物质的身份（接地）、检索供应商报价、选择有效的可购买包装规格、标准化数量并计算成本。我们推出了ChemCost基准，包含1,427个可评估的反应，基于涵盖2,261种化学品和230,775条供应商报价的冻结定价快照，支持标量评分以及对接地、检索、采购和算术等各阶段的错误诊断。
tldr: 提出ChemCost基准，利用化学品采购成本估算这一具有精确、无评判者真实标准的实际任务，首次对大语言模型智能体的科学工具使用能力（包括接地、检索、采购和算术）进行严格评估与分阶段诊断。
en_tdlr: Introduces ChemCost, a benchmark of 1,427 chemical reactions with frozen supplier pricing data, enabling rigorous, judge-free evaluation of LLM agents' scientific tool use through chemical procurement cost estimation with stage-level diagnosis of grounding, retrieval, procurement, and arithmetic failures.
